path.description: Absolute file or directory to search in. Defaults to the current working directory

glob.description: Glob that file paths must match, e.g. "*.js" or "**/*.{ts,tsx}"

type.description: ripgrep file type to search, e.g. js, py, rust, go

output_mode.description: content: matching lines; files_with_matches: file paths (default); count: matches per file

-n.description: Show line numbers (content mode, default true)

-A.description: Lines of context after each match (content mode)

-B.description: Lines of context before each match (content mode)

-C.description: Lines of context before and after each match (content mode)

multiline.description: Allow patterns to span lines; . matches newlines

head_limit.description: Return only the first N lines or entries
